as_told.title: Caretaker evacuated after cardiac episode during experiment

plain: While crews were drilling below the mesa at Skinwalker Ranch, a property famous for reports of strange events, the ranch caretaker Tom Lewis is said to have collapsed just as a radio signal at 1.6 gigahertz showed up on the instruments. The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, tells Michels he was there, and says, "Our caretaker ends up being brought to his knees." A second witness speaking on the same episode tells it a bit differently. This witness calls it a cardiac episode, a heart event, and says a man known as Dragon got the caretaker out at once. That account does not name the caretaker or mention the signal. Both describe the same moment in 2025 or 2026 during the digging. If the collapse and the signal were linked, it would mean something under the ranch can harm people when it is disturbed.
